findings.detail: The Consequences section now carries "**Deferred on 2026-08-13** at the maintainer's request", but the header block (Status: Accepted / Date: 2026-08-03) records only the original decision date. A reader arriving at an ADR dated 2026-08-03 and finding a statement dated ten days later cannot tell whether the ADR was amended or whether the date is wrong — and the file gives no signal that its body has moved since acceptance. This matters more here than in a normal doc because ADR-0005 is the document TD-026 links back to as the authority for what the Firebase removal did and did not settle; the two are now mutually cross-referencing, so the amendment trail is the only way to see which one moved last. Not a correctness problem: the added sentence is accurate and consistent with the register entry, and it explicitly defers detail to the register rather than duplicating the triggers.
findings.summary: ADR header still dates the file 2026-08-03 while a bullet now claims 2026-08-13
